title: Design and Migrate API Key Database Schema
description: Define and migrate the PostgreSQL schema for API keys, including fields for secure storage, user association, scopes, and auditability.
details: Use Drizzle ORM to define a new `apiKeys` table with the following fields: `id` (primary key), `userId` (foreign key to users), `hashedKey` (bcrypt hash), `keyPrefix` (for identification), `name` (user-defined), `status` (active/inactive), `scopes` (JSON array or enum), `expiresAt` (timestamp), `createdAt`, and `updatedAt`. Optionally, create an `apiKeyAuditLogs` table for tracking usage and changes. Generate and apply the migration using Drizzle Kit. Ensure referential integrity and add appropriate indexes for performance.
test_strategy:
- Write migration tests to verify table creation and constraints.
- Use Drizzle's type-safe queries to validate schema correctness.
- Test rollback and re-apply migrations in a staging environment.

title: Implement Secure Backend API Endpoints for Key Management
description: Develop Next.js API routes for creating, listing, and deleting API keys, ensuring secure generation, hashing, and user isolation.
details:
Create API endpoints under `app/api/v1/api-keys/` for:
- POST: Generate a new API key (using nanoid/crypto), hash with bcrypt, store only the hash, and return the full key (display once).
- GET: List all keys for the authenticated user.
- DELETE: Remove a key by ID (ensure user ownership).
- PATCH (optional): Update key status or metadata.
Integrate with Better Auth to ensure only the key owner can perform actions. Validate input with Zod. Log all key creation/deletion events in audit logs if implemented.
test_strategy:
- Unit test key generation and hashing logic.
- Integration test all endpoints for correct auth, isolation, and error handling.
- Attempt cross-user access to ensure isolation.
- Test that raw keys are never stored or retrievable after creation.

title: Develop API Key Authentication Middleware
description: Create middleware to validate API keys on protected AI endpoints, enforcing status, expiration, and scopes.
details:
Implement a middleware (e.g., in `lib/auth/apiKeyMiddleware.ts`) that:
- Parses the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header.
- Extracts the key prefix, finds the corresponding hash in the database, and compares using bcrypt.
- Checks key status (active), expiration, and required scopes for the endpoint.
- Attaches user context to the request if valid, or rejects with 401/403.
- Integrate with existing AI API routes (chat, search, image-gen) to support both session and API key auth.
test_strategy:
- Unit test middleware for valid/invalid/expired keys and scope enforcement.
- Integration test with protected endpoints using valid and invalid keys.
- Test performance with repeated requests (simulate caching if implemented).

title: Build Frontend UI for API Key Management in Dashboard
description: Create a user interface within the dashboard for managing API keys, supporting full CRUD operations and secure key display.
details:
- Add a new navigation link in `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` to `/dashboard/settings/api-keys`.
- Implement the page at `app/dashboard/settings/api-keys/page.tsx` as a Server Component to fetch and display the user's keys in a `shadcn/ui` Table.
- Create Client Components for:
  - 'Create New Key' dialog (shows full key only once, with copy warning).
  - 'Delete Key' confirmation dialog.
  - Status badges and scope indicators.
- Ensure all UI actions call the backend endpoints securely and update state optimistically.
test_strategy:
- E2E test the full user flow: create, view, delete keys.
- UI tests for correct display of key metadata, status, and error states.
- Test that full key is only shown once and cannot be retrieved again.

title: Enforce API Key Scope and Status in AI Feature Endpoints
description: Update AI feature API routes to require and enforce API key authentication, checking scopes and status for each request.
details:
- Refactor `/app/api/chat/route.ts` and similar endpoints to use the new API key middleware.
- Define required scopes for each AI feature (e.g., 'chat:read', 'chat:write', etc.).
- Ensure endpoints reject requests with missing, expired, or insufficient-scope keys.
- Log usage for auditability if audit logs are implemented.
test_strategy:
- Integration test endpoints with keys of varying scopes and statuses.
- Attempt unauthorized actions to verify correct rejection.
- Regression test to ensure session-based auth still works as expected.
